scores.tell: Slightly pale, even-lit water in the lower half; few dark accents. The overall key is otherwise close to the real cards.
The pale white dome and the saturated purple sky are well separated. The sand is a bit uniform and there is no vignette.
The big mid-value sky and water masses are flat. The pier is separated well by value, but there is no dark accent anywhere.
Dark pumpkin edges and the glowing face give good contrast. The purple rays are a bit even.
The black locomotive is the darkest mass. The hard value contrast and the busy, evenly bright desert background are slightly harsher than the real cards.
The near-identical train has a slightly harder dark mass and a busy background. Its key and contrast are similar to c214.
Yellow rope on a mid purple ground, separated by value and hue, with gentle local contrast. It reads like the real towel card.
The dark teal and navy rim against a flat yellow background is strong. The ring pattern is soft and the glow is limited.
The grey-blue gravestone is mid value against a mid orange wall and a pale floor. It has a low-contrast, muddy gradient and a washed-out floor that the real cards don't have.
The overall key is bright and even. The grey stone has little value separation from the busy green scene, and the darkest accents are weak.
